goal: Stop three recurring manual fixes on the Build line, as one task. (1) C13: build-spec.js's code-half Risk Router (HIGH_REF, used by codeRisk) stops flagging refs that only contain 'author'/'authored'/'authority' (e.g. '.claude/agents/test-author.md') as sensitive, while still flagging auth, authn, authz, authentication, authenticate(d), authorization/authorisation and every other existing term, with the rule's shape unchanged (schema/infra kinds high outright; other kinds only when the ref names a sensitive term; free text never matched). (2) B7 part 1: build-implement.js's Test Author prompt (the agent labelled `tests:${task.id}` inside runTask) tells the Test Author that a criterion whose THEN asserts something is unchanged / identical to before / not added or removed relative to the base is verified by the verifier panel at build time and must NOT get a test, and names which of this task's criteria are such; the list is computed in script by a new pure function changeScopedCriteria(acceptance) in the '// ---- BEGIN/END fix-loop decisions ----' block, using a copy of graph-lint's PANEL_PATTERNS phrase list (build-spec.js). (3) Lander reconciliation: a new pure normaliser in the fix-loop block reduces every tests_found / tests_landed / tests_skipped entry to a bare basename (trailing parenthetical note and any directory stripped) and is reused by unaccountedTestFiles and unlandedRepairs, so a lander reporting 'x.js (already exists)' no longer produces unaccounted files and a needless strong-tier integrate:resolve.

out_of_scope: Changing lens verdict derivation, the tiebreak judge, dispute rulings, testValidity, escapingImports, or any other fix-loop decision function beyond unaccountedTestFiles and unlandedRepairs
Changing any other workflow (build-reentry, create-project, launch, deploy, maintain-triage, improve-analyze, memory-roll)
Adding, removing, re-labelling, re-tiering or re-schemaing any agent() call, or changing any pipeline/parallel/phase call count
Changing HIGH_KINDS, the codeRisk reason strings, the Risk Router agent half, or matching free text (goal/intent) against HIGH_REF; exporting anything new from build-spec.js
Changing graph-lint's PANEL_PATTERNS or classifyCriterion in build-spec.js (the list is copied, not shared)
Changing the Suite/TestSet schemas or the integrate lander's prompt text
Removing or rewriting existing permanent tests that freeze change-scoped criteria (e.g. a5-bind-AC-13) beyond what is needed to keep the suite green
Any test that shells out to npm test
k16h (main session): substrate/test removed from touched_surfaces and owned_surfaces (Test Author surface, graph-lint check 5); re-linted in code clean, risk low, so no Spec Gate is required.
risk_reasons: No external consumers (client is self, venture 0 only)
All changes are internal to build process tooling in .claude/workflows/ and substrate/test

C13 refines the HIGH_REF regex to exclude author-related false positives while preserving all other sensitive-term detection; this is a refinement of the risk rule, not a break in the risk classification contract
B7 adds a new changeScopedCriteria() function and modifies the Test Author prompt to name change-scoped criteria; this is additive information, not a break in the Test Author's contract
Lander change adds testFileBasename normalizer to reconcile test files with trailing parentheticals; this fixes an edge case without breaking contracts
No infrastructure, auth, secrets, or payments infrastructure touches
No existing routes' contracts are broken for any client
